items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: an uncle of mine named Willie Darenbourg was a trombone player

ctx.x: All right. Now, the first thing I wanted to ask you, I wanted to dispel all the things that have been going around. People say you were related to Caffrey(?) Darenburg and related to Percy Darenburg. Who actually in your family were musicians? Anybody or no?

Nobody in my family were professional musicians. But an uncle of mine named Willie Darenbourg was a trombone player that played on the Ringling Brothers Circus and the Hagenbech(?)—Wallace Circus outside. And my father was an amateur musician.
So Percy Darenburg and Caffrey(?) Darenburg are no kin whatsoever.
